generation_guards: Show exactly one bear and exactly seven zebras.
The single bear must be white.
The bear must be visibly jumping over the zebras, positioned above them in midair.
All seven zebras must be visible as separate individual animals, not merged or hidden.
Avoid occlusion that would prevent counting the bear or any of the seven zebras.
Do not add extra bears or extra zebras.
initial_plan.generation_strategy: Use a clear side-view composition with the seven zebras arranged in a separated row below and the single white bear airborne above them, making the over/jumping relation unambiguous and keeping every animal fully visible for counting.
initial_plan.initial_prompt: A clear side-view image of exactly one white bear jumping over exactly seven zebras. The white bear is airborne above the zebras, with its whole body visible and clearly not touching the ground. The seven zebras are below the bear, arranged as seven separate individual zebras in a row with small gaps between them so each zebra can be counted. Keep all animals fully visible, avoid overlap and occlusion, and do not include any additional bears or zebras.
